title: Fun Experience!
text: Couple of friends and me decided to spend last Sunday afternoon in the Corpse Gallery Escape, and it was a great choice. We had a lot of fun! A bit difficult though 😅
author: MONICA N

title: Fun and engaging
text: It was the first time I did a escape game and it was so much fun. We did the Corpse Gallery Game and the multiple rooms had hidden clues that were smartly leading us to the resolution (I will not tell you what it was!) The plot and story was also cleverly structured. And most important we had a great time thorough the whole experience.
author: SaraWorldAdventures
